1462.name: Layer 1 X position mirror
1462.kind: word (little endian, low/high pair); also byte table at $1462+X
desc: Copy of layer 1 (main level) X scroll position kept for the scroll sprites and scroll deltas. Level start copies
the layer positions $001A-$0021 to $1462-$1469 (previous positions); the scroll code subtracts it to get
frame deltas ($17BD) and layer 2's position relative to layer 1 ([$26] = [$1466] - [$1462]).
Scroll sprites index $1462+X as the X position of the layer they move; Mario's left level border check uses it.
The ending enemy scene and boss rooms set it to 0. High byte is $1463.

1464.name: Layer 1 Y position mirror
1464.kind: word (little endian, low/high pair); also byte table at $1464+X
desc: Copy of layer 1 (main level) Y scroll position used by the scroll sprites and scroll-delta code.
The scroll code subtracts it to get the layer 1 Y delta ($17BC) and layer 2's Y relative to layer 1 ([$28]).
Scroll sprites index $1464+X as the Y position of the layer they move.
Set to $FF90 at Mario Start and to 0 for boss room Mode 7 setup. High byte is $1465.

1466.name: Layer 2 X position mirror
desc: Layer 2 (background) X scroll position as tracked by the layer 2 scroll sprites ($1462 is the layer 1 version).
Zeroed by scroll sprite init and the ending scene. The ON/OFF switch scroll sprite adds layer 1's X
movement ($17BD) to it; the scroll code derives the layer 2 X delta ($17BF) and [$26] from it.
Read by the layer 2 sink/rise and smash scroll sprites. High byte is $1467.

1468.name: Layer 2 Y position mirror
desc: Layer 2 (background) Y scroll position as tracked by the layer 2 scroll sprites ($1464 is the layer 1 version).
The smash scroll sprite starts it at $00C1; the sink/rise sprite starts it from a start-height table.
Read by the scroll code to derive the layer 2 Y delta ($17BE) and by the ON/OFF switch and layer 3 handlers.
High byte is $1469.

146A.name: Ending scene layer mirror
desc: Only seen written (set to 0) by the ending enemy scene setup, together with $1462 and $1466.
It sits in the layer position mirror block $1462-$1469 area, but no reader was found; its purpose is probably
just clearing a layer 3 position mirror (uncertain).

1470.name: Carrying sprite this frame
desc: Set when Mario is carrying a sprite (or picks one up). Set to 1 by the kick/carry pose start and incremented
when Mario grabs a sprite by bouncing/pressing on it ($01AA6B, which also sets the sprite's status to carried).
Each frame, before sprites run, it is loaded from $148F (last frame's carry flag).
Read together with Yoshi riding to stop some pickups (line guide, springboard, Yoshi code).
Values: 0 = not carrying; non-zero = carrying.

1471.name: Mario standing on sprite
desc: Non-zero when Mario is standing on a sprite platform this frame (platforms, springboards, Lakitu cloud,
bounce blocks, skull raft, chained platform...). Cleared to 0 at the start of the sprite run each frame; the
platform's code sets it again when it carries Mario. Read by Mario's ground speed and block/slope collision
so he is treated as on the ground and not pushed by tiles.
Values: 0 = not on a sprite; 1 = on a sprite or platform; 2 = on a springboard; 3 = on a moving platform
(chained platform, Banzai Bill platform, solid sprite).

1476.name: Spotlight left beam end
desc: Dark room spotlight effect: X of the left end of the beam. Set to 0 at the start of the effect and then
stepped each frame by a table indexed by the sweep direction ($1483), reversing when it hits a limit.
Used with $1478 (right end) to compute the window edges ($147A, $147C).

1478.name: Spotlight right beam end
desc: Dark room spotlight effect: X of the right end of the beam. Set to $90 at the start of the effect and then
stepped each frame like $1476 (left end). Used to compute the spotlight window edges.

147A.name: Spotlight left edge
desc: Dark room spotlight: the current left window edge while the routine builds the per-scanline HDMA window table.
Starts at $1472 each frame, then is stepped one pixel per line (a DDA with $147E as the accumulator) and
stored to the table at $04A0,X.

147C.name: Spotlight right edge
desc: Dark room spotlight: the current right window edge while building the per-scanline window table.
Starts at $1474 each frame, then is stepped per line using $147F as the accumulator.

147E.name: Spotlight left DDA accumulator
desc: Dark room spotlight: line-drawing (DDA) accumulator for the left edge ($147A). Zeroed at the start of each
frame's table build and updated while the left edge is stepped.

147F.name: Spotlight right DDA accumulator
desc: Dark room spotlight: line-drawing (DDA) accumulator for the right edge ($147C). Zeroed at the start of each
frame's table build and updated while the right edge is stepped.

1483.name: Spotlight sweep direction
desc: Dark room spotlight: which way the beam ends sweep. Zero at the start of the effect; it flips (0/1) when the
beam end reaches a limit from a table. Used as the index into the step tables for $1476/$1478.

148B.name: Random number state 1
desc: First of two seed bytes of the random number generator ($01AD07). Each call does [$148B] = [$148B] * 5 + 1
(carry included), and it is mixed with $148C (EOR) to produce $148D/$148E. Not meant to be read by game code.

148C.name: Random number state 2
desc: Second seed byte of the random number generator. Each call shifts it left and applies a bit-5 feedback tweak
(incrementing it in some cases). EORed with $148B to give the random outputs $148D and $148E.

148D.name: Random byte 1
desc: Random number produced by the generator at $01AD07 (called once per frame and again for a second output).
Read by sprites that need a random choice: Cheep Cheep, hopping flame, splashes and sparkles, para-enemies,
Boo/bat ceiling cluster sprite. $148E is the second random byte.

148E.name: Random byte 2
desc: Second random number from the generator at $01AD07 ($148D is the first). Read by Cheep Cheep, Magikoopa
magic, jumping fish and Eerie generators, cluster sprite loading, splashes/sparkles and Peach's scene.

148F.name: Mario carrying flag
desc: Non-zero while Mario is holding a sprite. Cleared to 0 every frame in the sprite run ($018095) after its
value is copied to $1470; a carried sprite's code sets it again that frame ($01A128 sets 1).
Read by Mario's pose selection (carry poses), walking and swimming, collision, pipe entry and the cape,
which all behave differently when he holds something.
Values: 0 = nothing carried; non-zero = carrying a sprite.

1490.name: Star power timer
desc: Frames of Mario star invincibility remaining. Set to $FF by the Star power-up ($01C582); cleared at level
start and by the goal tape. Read by Mario's drawing (palette cycle), hurt checks, block interaction, and
by sprites that need star contact (star kill, Chuck, Wiggler, Sumo Bro flame, Yoshi contact).
Values: 0 = no star.

1491.name: Sprite movement this frame
desc: Amount in pixels the current sprite moved this frame, used to carry Mario with platforms. Set to 0 at the
start of each sprite's main routine and written by the sprite position update routines (X and Y variants)
and chained platforms (platform X minus previous X).
Read by Mario-carrying code: orange and floating platforms, skull raft, Mega Mole, carrot top lift,
timed lift, scale platforms. Value is a signed 8-bit pixel delta.

1492.name: Level end walk pause timer
desc: Set to $40 when the scripted level-end walk starts ($00C99A) and counted down in Mario's physics jump
routine. When it reaches zero the end music/sequence continues (pause before the end music).
Values: 0 = not running.

1493.name: End of level timer
desc: Counts down once the level has been won: set to $FF by the goal tape, goal sphere, Big Boo, Ludwig and
Iggy/Larry boss deaths, or to 8 by block collision. While non-zero, level end handling runs (dithered palette
fade, scripted walk, status bar and IRQ changes) and Mario cannot be hurt.
Decremented by the scripted walk and boss routines. Game mode 14 skips the level-end work when it and the
Mario animation are both 0.
Values: 0 = level not ending.

1495.name: Event or fade step timer
1495.kind: byte (also start of the timer table $1495+X)
desc: Dual use. In the level end dithered palette fade it holds the fade step (set to step + 2); the IRQ code
compares it with $40. In the overworld event routine it is the event timer. Cleared at level start
and by the scripted walk. Per-frame Mario state also counts the bytes $1496-$14A8 down with
$1495,X (X=$13..1), so $1495 itself is not decremented there.

1496.name: Mario animation timer
desc: Timer for Mario's current animation, counted down by the animation code. Set by the walk animation frame
counter, power up ($01C567 and cape $18), kill/hurt ($00F61D); death decrements it every 4th frame.
Power down, mushroom, cape and flower power ups run until it reaches zero. Also read by swimming, climbing,
overworld border icons and the ending.
Values: 0 = timer expired. Also counted down by the per-frame loop over $1496-$14A8.

1497.name: Mario invincibility timer
desc: Frames Mario is flashing and cannot be hurt. Set to $7F by power down (about 2 seconds), $30 by cape soaring
ending, Yoshi contact and smoke puffs, and $FF at the start of normal animation 0 in some cases.
Read by the Mario drawing routine (flash), by Hurt Mario, and by enemy contact routines (Rex,
Dry Bones, stomp/kick/hurt) to skip damage.
Values: 0 = vulnerable.

1498.name: Pick-up pose timer
desc: Frames Mario shows the pick-up pose. Set to 8 when he grabs a sprite by bouncing/pressing on it
($01AA70) and set by the splash/Throw Block spawner. Cleared at level start.
Read by Mario's pose selection and carried-sprite positioning, and by cutscene command $20.
Values: 0 = not showing the pick-up pose.

1499.name: Face camera timer
desc: Frames Mario faces the camera. Set to 8 when he turns while carrying a sprite, and when entering a pipe.
Counted down (not below 0) in the horizontal pipe animation. Read by the pose chooser and the carried-sprite
routine, which positions the sprite in front of Mario when he faces the camera.
Values: 0 = not facing the camera.

149A.name: Kick pose timer
desc: Frames Mario shows the kick pose. Set to 12 when he kicks a sprite ($01A0AD) and to $10 by the Cheep Cheep
routine. Read by the Mario pose chooser. Cleared at level start.
Values: 0 = not kicking.

149B.name: Flashing palette timer
desc: Frames Mario's palette flashes during the flower power up. Set to $20 when he gets fire power ($01C5EE)
and decremented by the flower animation. Read by the Mario drawing routine to pick the flashing palette.
Values: 0 = not flashing.

149C.name: Fireball pose timer
desc: Frames Mario shows the fireball shoot pose. Set to $0A when he shoots a fireball ($00FEBC).
Read by the pose chooser and the swimming code.
Values: 0 = not shooting.

149E.name: Net punch timer
desc: Timer for Mario's punch on a climbing net. Read by the climbing code and the climbing net door; the
per-frame timer loop counts it down. The set code was not seen in the samples (probably set on punch).

149F.name: Cape takeoff timer
desc: Cape flight timer. Set to $70 in normal animation (when the run meter fills) and to $50 when a ground jump
allows takeoff; incremented in the cape flight code, which checks for >= 2 to leave it alone.
Also ORed in the screen scroll routine so the screen can scroll vertically while flying.
Values: 0 = not taking off or flying.

14A2.name: Cape image timer
desc: Timer for the cape's animation image. Set by the cape image update (value doubled in water) and read by the
air cape image code. The horizontal pipe animation decrements it. Also read by the overworld border icon
and ending sprites.
Values: 0 = timer expired.

14A3.name: Yoshi tongue timer
desc: Timer for Yoshi's tongue animation. Set to $12 when the tongue starts ($01F30B) and cleared when Yoshi eats
a berry. Read by Yoshi drawing (mouth/tongue state, compared to $10) and by Yoshi's pose code.
Values: 0 = tongue not out.

14A5.name: Cape float timer
desc: Floating timer of the cape: set to $10 when a float (glide) starts in the cape flight code, and while it is
running the code adjusts Mario's Y speed. Also shifted left once by the layer 3 scroll handler.
Values: 0 = not floating.

14A6.name: Cape spin timer
desc: Frames of Mario's cape spin. Set to $12 when the spin starts ($00D078). The pose chooser ORs it with the
spin jump flag to show the spin pose; swimming also reads it.
Values: 0 = not spinning with the cape.

14AB.name: Bonus game end timer
desc: Probably a bonus game timer. Set to $58 when there is no match in the bonus game and when the bonus 1-up
cluster sprite runs out. Game mode 14 treats 0 as the end of the bonus game; Mario state code compares it
to $44 every 4th frame while bonus mode ($1425) is on.
Values: 0 = bonus game finished.

14AD.name: Blue P-switch timer
desc: Frames left of the active blue P-switch. Set to $B0 (176) when Mario hits a blue switch ($14AD+Y with Y
selecting blue or silver, see $14AE). Cleared at level start. Read by block interaction, Mario drawing,
animated tiles, Directional Coins, pipe code and the P-switch tile swaps (which restore tiles at 0).
Values: 0 = blue switch not active.

14AE.name: Silver P-switch timer
desc: Frames left of the active silver P-switch (partner of $14AD). Cleared at level start. Read by the P-switch
tile swaps, Mario drawing, spawn routines and Directional Coins, which return while a P-switch is active.

14AF.name: ON/OFF switch state
desc: State of the ON/OFF switch: read by the line guide, bounce blocks (to choose the ON/OFF blocks) and cleared
by the layer 2 ON/OFF scroll sprite at level start (set to ON).
Values: 0 = ON; non-zero = OFF.

14B0.name: Pivot X or Bowser phase timer
14B0.kind: word (little endian, low/high pair) or timer
desc: Shared scratch. For chained platforms and the Mode 7 rotated tile check it is the pivot X (platform X minus
radius, or Mode 7 center X [$2A]); $14B1 is the high byte. Lakitu's cloud draw stores the cloud screen X here.
In the Bowser fight it is the phase timer: Bowser states and the attack scheduler wait for it to hit 0.
Meaning differs by routine.

14B1.name: Pivot X high or Mecha drop timer
desc: High byte of the platform pivot X ($14B0). In the Bowser fight it is the Mechakoopa drop timer: set by the
attack scheduler, read by the drop and throw routine, and cleared ($03A666) when Bowser is hurt.

14B2.name: Pivot Y or Bowser scale stage
14B2.kind: word (little endian, low/high pair) or index
desc: Shared scratch. For chained platforms and the Mode 7 check it is pivot Y (sprite Y minus radius, or Mode 7
center Y [$2C]); $14B3 is the high byte. Lakitu's cloud draw stores the cloud screen Y here.
In the Bowser retreat it is the scale stage (index into a table), cleared to 0 when the retreat starts.

14B3.name: Pivot Y high or Bowser hit timer
desc: High byte of the platform pivot Y ($14B2). In the Bowser fight it counts up as the Bowser-hit effect timer
for the hit stars and puffs, and is reset to 0 when Bowser takes a hit ($03B120).
